== Card credits ==
Kurt Moss is credited with the original concept of three Players Committee [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards are in [[Virtual Set 5]] (released 23 November 2016) and [[Virtual Set 8]] (released 30 November 2017).

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! Set !! Released !! Credit as printed
|-
| [[Dengar (V)|•Dengar (V)]] || [[Virtual Set 5]] || 23 November 2016 || "Original concept by Kurt Moss"
|-
| [[Luke Skywalker, The Rebellion's Hope|•Luke Skywalker, The Rebellion's Hope]] || [[Virtual Set 8]] || 30 November 2017 || "Original concept by Andrew Moss and Kurt Moss"
|-
| [[Luke Skywalker, The Rebellion's Hope (ALT)|•Luke Skywalker, The Rebellion's Hope (AI)]] || [[Virtual Set 8]] || 30 November 2017 || "Original concept by Andrew Moss and Kurt Moss"
|}

The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Kurt Moss|Kurt Moss]] on [[Card Credits]].
